name: Nightshift
eyebrow: A small toolkit for the late shift
tagline: Move files. Shape data. Ship clean.
description: A compact command-line utility that turns the awkward middle of a workflow into a one-liner. Fast enough to disappear, opinionated enough to trust.

products.name: Shape
products.description: Move between JSON, YAML, CSV, and env files without pulling a whole runtime into the room.

products.name: Check
products.description: Validate payloads against schemas, with errors that point to the line you actually need to fix.

products.name: Ship
products.description: Compose small transforms into scripts that run the same on your laptop, CI, and a clean machine.
